field_dictionary.candidate_date: D-1 trading date; candidate belongs to that date's vendor limit_up event pool.
field_dictionary.outcome_date: D trading date, the prediction target date.
field_dictionary.vendor_streak_length: Consecutive prior calendar sessions ending D-1 with this code in vendor limit_up; not official close-limit board height.
field_dictionary.limit_up_count_3: Number of appearances in vendor limit_up over D-1 and prior two sessions.
field_dictionary.limit_up_count_5: Number of appearances in vendor limit_up over D-1 and prior four sessions.
field_dictionary.limit_down_count_5: Number of appearances in vendor limit_down over D-1 and prior four sessions.
field_dictionary.days_since_limit_down: Trading-session distance from D-1 to most recent prior vendor limit_down event; null means none in retained history.
field_dictionary.recent_limit_up_acceleration: limit_up appearances in the latest 3 sessions minus the preceding 3 sessions, all ending no later than D-1.
field_dictionary.vendor_limit_up_count: Number of unique codes in D-1 vendor limit_up pool.
field_dictionary.vendor_limit_down_count: Number of unique codes in D-1 vendor limit_down pool.
field_dictionary.vendor_limit_break_count: Number of unique codes in D-1 vendor limit_break event pool.
field_dictionary.limit_up_pool_change_3_sessions: D-1 vendor limit_up pool size minus size three sessions earlier.
field_dictionary.limit_up_pool_change_5_sessions: D-1 vendor limit_up pool size minus size five sessions earlier.
field_dictionary.lagged_continuation_rate: Prior-session vendor limit_up overlap divided by previous session's candidate pool size, available by event date only in the constructed chronology.
field_dictionary.lagged_continuation_change_3_sessions: Mean of latest three prior-session continuation rates minus preceding three; no D or later outcomes.
field_dictionary.theme_hhi: Herfindahl concentration of vendor theme assignments among D-1 candidate codes; multi-theme assignments split each code's weight evenly.
field_dictionary.continuation_D: D vendor limit_up pool membership; outcome only.
field_dictionary.down_next_D: D vendor limit_down pool membership; outcome only.
field_dictionary.down_three_D_to_D2: Any vendor limit_down membership over D,D+1,D+2; null unless the entire window stays within its research phase.

unavailable: candidate minute bars and order-level fills
data_availability.limit_up_pool_semantics: Historical vendor event-pool membership; not certified close-only limit-up status.
data_availability.theme_semantics: Vendor theme labels; no sector/core/leadership truth is implied.

feature_matrix_source_sha_scope: Partition SHA256 values are stored per row; archive SHA256 values are recorded in the aggregate report.
